items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: And there was an agent, Arthur Lyons, who was a Russian, and he got in touch with other Russians who came to New York and put up the money to create a large Negro review to tour Europe. And we were organized... Arthur Lyons did the choral... and that's how we happened to get the European engagement.

ctx.x: And there was an agent, Arthur Lyons, who was a Russian, and he got in touch with other Russians who came to New York and put up the money to create a large Negro review to tour Europe. And we were organized -- incidentally, Duke Ellington wrote the music for this review, this show. And we had a show of 53 people. We first landed in Germany and we played Germany. Toured all of Europe, then we went to Russia. Stayed in Russia about -- almost a year.
Now, this was obviously by boat that you traveled.
